notes.title: Wolfsong OST
notes.content:
If anyone is interested in the OST of Wolfsong, it can be found at Mandi Nittinger's Bandcamp page https://mandinittinger.bandcamp.com/album/wolfsong
I think she did a wonderful job and really breathed life into Lorestrome. Couldn't have finished the game without her!
-Hyptosis
